name: Tile / Active Project
description: Active Project product scenario for the Tile component.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Label of the row; plain text truncates, rich content keeps its own layout.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Visual variant.

controls.name: density
controls.description: Density adjusts internal padding while keeping the shared control rhythm.

controls.name: tone
controls.description: Semantic visual tone for muted, accent, status, or destructive rows.

controls.name: actionVisibility
controls.description: Controls how the actions slot is revealed.

controls.name: icon
controls.description: Icon (string from registry or ReactNode).

controls.name: iconPosition
controls.description: Icon at the start or end of the label, following text direction. Default: start.

controls.name: leading
controls.description: Isolated leading slot for nested controls such as disclosure or file action buttons.

controls.name: meta
controls.description: Secondary text or status at the inline end of the row, before actions.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable the primary action. Nested controls own their disabled state.

controls.name: active
controls.description: Active / selected state.

controls.name: interactive
controls.description: Enable a primary action; inferred from onClick, aria-expanded or an explicit button/tab role.

controls.name: stretchText
controls.description: Stretch text area (flex:1).

controls.name: chevron
controls.description: Trailing disclosure chevron: `down` flips with aria-expanded; `end` points to the inline end, mirrors in right-to-left text and turns down when expanded.

controls.name: aria-expanded
controls.description: Expanded state of the controlled region; makes the row a disclosure button and orients the chevron.

controls.name: aria-busy
controls.description: Busy state of the row region, reflected by the wait cursor.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Full width tile.

controls.name: align
controls.description: Inline alignment of the content, following text direction. Default: start.

controls.name: indent
controls.description: Indent steps for nested rows, an integer from 0 to 9.

controls.name: truncate
controls.description: Truncate overflowing text content with ellipsis.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the tile.

controls.name: actions
controls.description: Nested action buttons at the inline end; their clicks do not reach the tile.
